get.summary: Retrieve Model Field Schema and Visibility
get.description: Fetches all fields for a specified model and indicates visibility based on the authenticated user's settings. Defaults to visible if no setting exists.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The name of the Django model (case-insensitive, e.g., 'User' or 'Product')

model.description: The name of the model queried

fields.description: List of fields with their visibility status

name.description: The programmatic name of the field

label.description: A user-friendly label for the field

visible.description: Indicates if the field is currently set to be visible for the user

400.description: Bad Request (e.g., missing 'model' parameter, invalid model name)

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to set the visibility (true/false) for multiple fields of a specific model. Settings are stored per user.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g., invalid input format, invalid model name, invalid field name)
